name: vidar
description: Odin with closures, interfaces, cyclic imports and typed macros: syntax highlighting and language server client

semanticTokenModifiers.description: A variable captured by a closure, used inside it
Captured by reference (`proc[&x]`): writes reach the variable
A closure value or closure type, as opposed to a plain proc

commands.title: Vidar: Toggle -opt in Expand at Cursor

vidar.server.path.description: Language server to run: an executable name or path, or the path to dist/lsp/server.js. Leave unset to use the server bundled in the extension, falling back to vidar-lsp on PATH.

vidar.odinCheckOnSave.description: Run `odin check` on the generated code when saving, and show Odin's errors on the .vidar lines.

vidar.odinPath.description: Odin compiler used for checks on save.

vidar.ols.description: Ask ols (the Odin language server) about plain Odin code: hover, go to definition, completion and signature help for core library procs, types and fields.

vidar.olsPath.description: ols executable used when `vidar.ols` is on.

enumDescriptions: Show what -opt does: tables, specialized copies, unchecked indexing, grouped allocations, compiled fmt calls, devirtualized interface calls.
Also show what -opt considered and didn't do, with the reason in the tooltip.
vidar.optHints.description: Inlay hints showing what `-opt` decides, without building with it. Hover a hint for the reason.

vidar.optCodeLens.description: A code lens over each proc with `-opt` decisions, "N optimizations, M not", that opens the Optimization Report on that proc. None while `vidar.optHints` is off.
